source.version: Live snapshot 2026-10-20; page release marker c42d8c1
source.researchMethod: REA capture_browser_scenario (launch and connect), retained actual REA Evidence, with a labeled public projection and privately retained complete originals; independent isolated-profile Playwright/CDP screenshots, computed styles, CSS declarations and node-scoped platform fonts. The initial anonymous capture used no credentials or content generation; the authenticated supplement used two neutral UI fixture prompts, without backend-protocol or output-quality testing. Supplement: normal user login, CUA Chrome extension scoped captures, synthetic project/chat, selected original component CSS/SVG reuse; no private history exported.

authentication.conditions: User completed normal login in Chrome; anonymous DPR1 and authenticated DPR1.75 captures remain separately identified.

scope.goal: 将Kimi网页的视觉、组件、关键动效和通用交互用于其他业务；包含正常登录后的代表设计。
included: 登录门槛弹层的视觉与Esc保留
正常登录后的中性研究项目、说明保存/取消、会话富文本与生成过渡、插件空搜索和技能目录
excludedBusiness: AI推理算法与生成质量验收（只发起两条中性UI样本请求）
私人历史内容、认证协议、安全测试、会员收费
第三方授权、真实安装与上传
原产品完整业务功能克隆

supportedUses: 公开首页、导航、输入底托、菜单、亮暗色与窄屏
已登录的项目空态、说明编辑、正文/表格/代码、生成中控件、插件搜索与技能目录的代表设计
直接复用16个原始SVG、两张通用项目插画、原系统字体栈与精选组件CSS
Reading Room及集合/笔记/发现页面的可运行迁移样例
optionalGaps: 未触发真实网络错误；停止后的后端取消与晚到结果未知，目标采用显式D策略。
真实移动UA/软键盘、原版完整键盘/读屏、全部账号与后台业务分支未测。
动效时间主要是B声明；原版未逐帧测量。

reference.description: 主页与登录后代表布局已实际配对；字体/图标/组件复用路径和D差异明确列出，不声称全产品逐像素相同。

crossDomain.description: Reading Room的本地创建/集合/筛选/完成/刷新持久化和画廊分类通过执行检查。

distribution.authorization: Owner requested uploading the completed Kimi Web design study to ECdison6227/rea-ui-library in this conversation.
omissions: Browser profiles, cookies, storage, credentials, private account/history/selector images and caches are excluded.
Source login QR images and full original DOM snapshots are withheld with actual SHA256.
Synthetic project/chat URL identifiers are removed from public JSON; the underlying source capture conditions and original hashes are retained.
Complete original REA record is kept privately; the public projection preserves real Evidence IDs, screenshots, actions and limitations.
distribution.publication: Prepared as a reviewed public addition at platforms/web/kimi-web; Android Kimi remains a separate source.
